title: Deferred Calls Crash During Scene Initialization
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.3 dev

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot 4.3 - Compatibility

### Issue description

Calling `set_deferred` or `call_deferred` from a thread during scene initialization crashes. Doesn't matter if it's my own variable or a builtin variable or callable. Emitting a signal instead of deferred call will emit the following error but not crash.

```
E 0:00:02:0768   test_thread_deferred.tscn::GDScript_ti8re:14 @ query_mouse(): Caller thread can't call this function in this node (/root/TestThreadDeferred/ColorRect). Use call_deferred() or call_thread_group() instead.
  <C++ Error>    Condition "!is_accessible_from_caller_thread()" is true. Returning: (ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER)
  <C++ Source>   scene/main/node.cpp:3894 @ emit_signalp()
  <Stack Trace>  test_thread_deferred.tscn::GDScript_ti8re:14 @ query_mouse()
```

### Steps to reproduce

Here's the class that reproduces it.

1) Make a new 2D scene
2) add a ColorRect node and attach the following script
3) Run scene a few times, it crashes sometimes (that's why I have a sleep on main thread in there)
4) Uncomment `this_wont_crash` to see it doesn't crash if we delay it until the first process frame

```gdscript
extends ColorRect

var query_thread: Thread = Thread.new()
var exit_thread = false
var this_wont_crash = false

func query_mouse() -> void:
	while not exit_thread:
		#if not this_wont_crash:
			#continue
		set_deferred("visible", true)


func _ready() -> void:
	if not query_thread.is_started():
		query_thread.start(query_mouse)
	# add some time to make crash more likely to happen
	OS.delay_msec(1000)  # Pauses for 1 seconds
	#await get_tree().create_timer(1.0).timeout


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	#this_wont_crash = true
	pass


func _exit_tree():
	exit_thread = true
	query_thread.wait_to_finish()
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

See reproducible steps with the script.
